verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs for most popular languages and frameworks. The evidence covers mobile (Android, which automatically reports errors and exceptions, and Apple via sentry-cocoa), backend (.NET, where error monitoring starts on SentrySdk.Init(), and Elixir, with automatic error reporting), and Dart, which automatically reports uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections. Web frontend support is only implied by the JavaScript source-maps docs, not by an explicit browser auto-capture statement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser/JavaScript uncaught-error auto-capture, independent hands-on corroboration of automatic capture across platforms.
